content: A plain Python bounded agentic loop needs no agent framework. Pattern: (1) for step in range(max_steps): run fdars → build_diagnostics → compare to target → break if target met or no improvement. (2) State is entirely in the messages list; no framework needed. (3) A hard step-budget (e.g., 10) prevents infinite loops and is the idiomatic safety fence. The LLM proposes a parameter change (structured output), Python executes it by calling fdars directly. This is exactly the _augment.py cluster_optim() pattern already present in fdars but guided by LLM instead of a scoring function.
